hooks.command: input=$(cat); echo "$input" | jq -e '.stop_hook_active == true' >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; changed=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null); ahead=$(git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); [ -z "$changed" ] && [ "$ahead" = "0" ] && exit 0; jq -n '{decision:"block",reason:"Comment pass: re-read the code you changed this turn (git diff, and any commits you made) and review every comment you added. Keep one only if it states something the code cannot: why this approach, what breaks without it, what a reader would otherwise \"fix\". Cut incident narrative - that belongs in the commit message and PR body - restatements of what the line does, and anything past ~4 lines you could not defend in review. See the Comments section of CLAUDE.md. If you added no comments, or they already pass, say so in one line and finish."}'
